title: 第一卷 第22章 占尽便宜的人
content_zh:
霍放语气很轻，但透着霸道的意味。

    童喻眼神没敢往下看，“我们的关系不需要牵扯太深了。”

    霍放利索地穿上了衬衣，听到她这句话，定定地看着她，“你怎么定义我们之间的关系？”

    “如果，我们是正常的男女朋友，奔着过一辈子去的，我愿意接受你的安排。”

    霍放扣着扣子的动作停了下来。

    童喻目光平静，心境也很平和。

    只是一段露出情缘而已，在一起的时候，大家开心就好。

    合则睡，不合就当做陌生人。

    童喻不敢把他们的关系定义得太美好了。

    “呵。”霍放继续扣着扣子，勾着嘴唇，睨着她，“我还以为，你真的只是想利用我的名头在夜场混得开一点。”

    童喻上前，伸手抢掉他手上的活儿，“像我这种底层里的女孩子，心里怎么会没有一个飞上枝头当凤凰的念头呢。”

    “二少人帅多金，不管是面子还是里子都无可挑剔。我要是没点想法，那就不正常了。”

    童喻给他扣好衬衣扣子，手掌轻轻贴着他的胸膛，帮他顺了一下。

    她心里清楚得很，霍放不过是喜欢她的身体。

    正好，她没有什么羞耻心。

    两个人算是一丘之貉，都不是什么善男信女。

    霍放任由她的手在自己身上游走。

    只是正常的整理衣服，指尖的温度透过衣料钻进他的身体里，如火燎过。

    “不会再提了。”

    童喻退后一步，媚眼的笑意温柔缱绻。

    “秦少约你吃晚饭，你赶紧去吧。”

    童喻看了眼外面的天。

    下大雨的缘故，这天比往常黑得更早。

    霍放“嗯”了一声。

    秦柯什么都给霍放准备了，从头到脚，从里到外。

    鞋子和袜子都是新的。

    他赤脚坐在门口的矮凳上，弯着腰穿袜子，这姿势看着确实是有些滑稽。

    童喻真心认为委屈他了。

    他换了鞋子，打开了门。
content_en:
Huo Fang's tone was very soft, but it conveyed a domineering tone.

    Tong Yu didn't dare to look down, "Our relationship doesn't need to be too deep."

    Huo Fang put on his shirt neatly. Hearing her words, he looked at her intently, "How do you define the relationship between us?"

    "If we are normal boyfriend and girlfriend and spend our lives together, I am willing to accept your arrangement."

    Huo Fang stopped buttoning his buttons.

    Tong Yu's eyes were calm and his mood was peaceful.

    It's just a romantic relationship. When we are together, everyone is happy.

    If we get along, we'll sleep together; if we don't get along, we'll be treated as strangers.

    Tong Yu didn't dare to define their relationship too beautifully.

    "Heh." Huo Fang continued to button his buttons, curled his lips, and stared at her, "I thought you really just wanted to use my name to get away in the nightclub."

    Tong Yu stepped forward, reached out and snatched the work from his hands, "How could a girl from the bottom like me not have the thought of flying up a branch and becoming a phoenix?"

    "The second young man is handsome and rich. He is impeccable both in terms of appearance and appearance. If I don't have any ideas, it would be abnormal."

    Tong Yu buttoned up his shirt, put her palms gently against his chest, and smoothed it for him.

    She knew very well that Huo Fang just liked her body.

    Fortunately, she has no shame.

    The two of them are the same, neither of them are good men or women.

    Huo Fang let her hands roam around his body.

    He was just arranging his clothes normally, and the warmth of his fingertips penetrated into his body through the clothes, like fire.

    "Won't mention it again."

    Tong Yu took a step back, his charming smile gentle and affectionate.

    "Master Qin invites you to dinner, you should go quickly."

    Tong Yu glanced at the sky outside.

    Because of the heavy rain, it got dark earlier than usual.

    Huo Fang said "hmm".

    Qin Ke had prepared everything for Huo Fang, from head to toe, inside and out.

    Shoes and socks are new.

    He was sitting barefoot on a low stool at the door, bending over to put on his socks. This posture did look a bit funny.

    Tong Yu truly felt that he had been wronged.

    He changed his shoes and opened the door.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 22 The person who takes advantage
